preregistration.scope: Reuse official BoT-SORT native detector-feature memory; development-only identity experiment
preregistration.source: Installed Ultralytics 8.3.228. A local subclass fixes BOTrack feature-deque initialization order. Installed packages are unchanged.
preregistration.detector: Same frozen YOLO11n-seg and exact shared predictions for both trackers; native features from its existing forward, no new neural model/download/training
preregistration.tracking: Same baseline confidence, Kalman, buffer, motion and GMC settings. ReID enables the library's native feature encoder and uses its published 0.8 appearance threshold. The disabled baseline's 0.25 field was unused.
preregistration.fairness: Each image is forwarded once, and GMC is estimated once from the same high-confidence detections then shared. Empty-mask filtering and tracker indexing preserve matching features/class-score rows.
preregistration.data: 12 already inspected development scenes, 483 frames. Official panoptic point GT is used only by the observer. New holdout remains closed.
preregistration.metrics: Whole-scan and camera-observable point IDF1/AQ, identity switches with coverage denominators, per-log results, native feature/tracker timing. These are not official MOT/PAT scores.
preregistration.gate: Identity continuation requires at least +1 pp camera-domain point IDF1 with no whole-scan loss and a majority of logs improving under the same geometric policy. No threshold sweep after inspection. Full objective still requires independently verified semantic gains and online deployment.
preregistration.attribution: An interface repair is not a learned-memory contribution. This experiment compares the repaired same-input baseline with native ReID and reports coverage changes.
